description: A static (decoration) field that is right-aligned. Static fields bypass the width constraint in Fabric (generate_card_html.php:644 passes width 0, card-editor.js:735 then forces originX left at x), but CardPDFRenderer still hands render-card-pdf.py a w_pt, so R2 anchors it from x + width.
provenance: static_N key naming and the is_static/detected_text/render_in_bg trio from includes/CardifyTemplateImporter.php:67-142. render_in_bg is false because the parser redacted the text from the background, which is the case the importer comment at :113-121 calls out.
